title: Integrated HSM failover, cert-sync controller, and Terraform upgrade hooks for private installer
author: Aisha Varma
release_notes: Adds HSM-priority failover orchestration, a cert-sync controller for sealed-secrets/Vault workloads, and Terraform pre/post-upgrade hooks to snapshot and validate keys. No user API changes; operator upgrade required.
description: This PR implements three coordinated pieces of work to make private installer upgrades safer for customers using external KMS/HSM and sealed-secrets: 1) HSM failover orchestration: introduce an HSMProfile CRD and a lightweight operator that implements priority-based failover between primary HSM and local software KMS, including a quiesce window before key rewraps; 2) cert-sync controller: an admission-aware controller that watches SealedSecret resources and Vault role/cert leases and ensures TLS certs remain synchronized across pods during rolling upgrades, with metrics and optional Prometheus annotation; 3) Terraform upgrade hooks: pre-upgrade snapshot and post-upgrade validation hooks for the terraform module which export key metadata to a secure artifact store and perform a dry-run key-access check after upgrades. Motivation: several customers experienced transient token errors and certificate expiry race conditions when moving to v2.3 with external KMS. This change reduces blast radius during upgrades by providing automated snapshots, failover paths, and an opinionated cert synchronization mechanism. Checklist: - [x] CRD definitions and controller reconciler implemented - [x] Terraform hooks added to module and documented - [x] Helm values and templates updated for cert-sync sidecar - [x] End-to-end test harness for upgrade path added - [x] Prometheus metrics and alert rules added - [x] Backwards-compatible defaults to avoid immediate operator changes Upgrade notes: operator must be installed before upgrading control-plane components; terraform apply should be run with `--target=module.kms` for the pre-upgrade snapshot step if using external KMS; Helm values `certSync.enabled=true` are recommended for clusters with rolling update strategies shorter than 5m. Security notes: snapshots are encrypted with customer KMS keys; snapshot artifacts are written to the customer's S3/GCS bucket (configurable); HSM private keys are never exported—failover performs rewrap/attestation flows only. Testing: unit tests cover reconciler logic; integration harness simulates primary HSM failure and validates automated failover and cert sync during a 3-node rolling upgrade; Terraform test workspace verifies pre/post hooks. Docs: adds an installer guide section with diagrams and a migration checklist (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/hsm-upgrades). Known limitations: cross-region HSM failover is not automated in this PR (planned follow-up ENG-5145); operator assumes a single primary HSM endpoint per profile. Contact: @aisha for rollout coordination.
